description.en: Architecture reading for Azure agent runtimes and Alibaba's Tongyi, cloud infrastructure and T-Head stack.
description.zh: 围绕 Azure 智能体运行时，以及阿里通义、云基础设施与平头哥技术栈的架构阅读资料。

finding.en: Compare runtime isolation, state and infrastructure boundaries—not a leaderboard.
finding.zh: 比较运行时隔离、状态与基础设施边界，而非性能排行榜。

description.en: Public workshops covering Fabric IQ and cross-cloud data comparisons, FabCon & SQLCon 2026, and VM modernization with FinOps.
description.zh: 公开实战课程涵盖 Fabric IQ 与跨云数据平台比较、FabCon 与 SQLCon 2026，以及 VM 现代化与 FinOps。

finding.en: Architecture comparisons and browser-local teaching tools have distinct evidence boundaries.
finding.zh: 架构比较与浏览器本地教学工具采用不同的证据边界。

description.en: Reusable solution-architect skills for video creation, Hermes WeChat, Chorus deployment, invoice PDF editing and Foundry quota inspection.
description.zh: 可复用的解决方案架构师技能，覆盖视频制作、Hermes 微信接入、Chorus 部署、账单 PDF 编辑与 Foundry 配额查询。

finding.en: Video styles separate look, layout, motion and sound; operational skills keep their own contracts.
finding.zh: 视频风格正交拆分视觉、布局、动效与声音；运维技能各自保留独立操作契约。

description.en: Copilot and HVE engineering workshop with a speaker outline, a reproducible runbook and an offline agentic-commerce demo.
description.zh: Copilot 与 HVE 工程实践课程，配套讲者大纲、可复现操作手册与离线智能体商业演示。

finding.en: The commerce demo is an offline simulation—not live payments or production authorization.
finding.zh: 商业演示属于离线模拟，并非真实支付或生产授权。

description.en: AI infrastructure research spanning GPU kernels, memory, interconnects and distributed systems, with source and evidence ledgers.
description.zh: 覆盖 GPU 内核、内存、互连与分布式系统的 AI 基础设施研究，配有来源与证据账本。

finding.en: Separate implementation sources, specifications and offline models before interpreting results.
finding.zh: 解读结果之前，先区分实现源码、架构规范与离线模型。

description.en: Benchmark methodology and tooling for frozen task contracts, attempt evidence, deterministic checks and visual report generation.
description.zh: 基准评测方法与工具，覆盖冻结任务契约、执行证据、确定性检查与视觉报告生成。

finding.en: Keep API evaluations, coding-agent runs and mock data distinct; missing cost is unknown.
finding.zh: 区分 API 评测、编码智能体运行与模拟数据；缺失成本仍为未知。

description.en: Public research archive connecting agent infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and engineering-method comparisons.
description.zh: 公开研究归档，串联智能体基础设施、编排框架与工程方法比较。

finding.en: Follow each module's source and verifier rather than treating archive summaries as new measurements.
finding.zh: 追溯各模块来源与验证器，不把归档摘要当作本站新增实测。

title.zh: 数据与基础设施实验室 · 来源资料集

finding.en: Trace sandbox isolation and state, then compare data platforms and VM trade-offs.
finding.zh: 从沙箱隔离与状态管理，延伸到数据平台与 VM 选型取舍。

description.en: Fabric IQ versus Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift; OneLake, Mirroring and digital twins. AKSClaw / E2B 100K and D96as_v7 capacity scenarios, FabCon & SQLCon, VM modernization and FinOps. These are source-described architectures and fixtures, not site-measured performance or live prices.
description.zh: Fabric IQ 对比 Databricks、Snowflake、BigQuery 与 Redshift；OneLake、Mirroring 与数字孪生。涵盖 AKSClaw / E2B 100K 与 D96as_v7 容量场景、FabCon 与 SQLCon、VM 现代化与 FinOps。均为来源架构或夹具，不代表本站实测性能或实时价格。

title.zh: Azure SA 技能与 HVE 资料库

finding.en: Composable skill contracts connect creative workflows with operational runbooks.
finding.zh: 以可组合的技能契约，连接创作流程与运维操作手册。

description.en: Explore orthogonal video styles, Hermes with WeChat, Chorus on ACA, anchor-based invoice PDF editing, Foundry quota inspection and the companion HVE workshop. Deployment instructions and offline demos are not production-readiness guarantees.
description.zh: 探索正交视频风格、Hermes 微信接入、Chorus ACA 部署、基于文本锚点的账单 PDF 编辑、Foundry 配额查询，以及配套 HVE 课程。部署指引与离线演示不构成生产就绪保证。
